requirements.title: Minimum average turnover
requirements.criterion: Average annual turnover over the last 3 audited financial years must be at least ₹5.00 crore.

requirements.title: GST registration
requirements.criterion: Active GSTIN with regular GSTR-3B filings for the preceding 6 months.

requirements.title: Udyam / MSME registration
requirements.criterion: Valid Udyam certificate, required only when claiming MSE benefits such as EMD exemption.

requirements.title: Make in India local content
requirements.criterion: Minimum 50% local content (Class-I local supplier) per the Public Procurement (Make in India) Order.

requirements.title: OEM authorization
requirements.criterion: Manufacturer authorization with back-to-back warranty, valid for at least 90 days after technical bid opening.

requirements.title: Earnest Money Deposit (EMD)
requirements.criterion: EMD of ₹2,00,000 by online payment or bank guarantee from a scheduled bank. Bids with short EMD are liable for rejection. MSEs may claim exemption.

requirements.title: PAN & income tax returns
requirements.criterion: Valid PAN and ITR acknowledgements for FY 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26.

requirements.title: EPFO & ESIC compliance
requirements.criterion: Active EPFO and ESIC codes with the latest monthly electronic challan (ECR).

requirements.title: Past execution record
requirements.criterion: At least 2 completed contracts for similar safety equipment to PSU or oil & gas customers.

requirements.title: Product test certificates
requirements.criterion: NABL-accredited lab test certificates for EN 137 / IS 10245 respiratory equipment.

requirements.title: Non-blacklisting undertaking
requirements.criterion: Affidavit confirming no debarment by CPPP, MoPNG or CPCL.

requirements.title: Land border declaration
requirements.criterion: Declaration regarding bidders from countries sharing a land border with India (GFR Rule 144(xi)).
